description: Mark one task on a hire done or skipped, with the day it happened. done counts toward the percent complete; skipped is a deliberate dismissal and never counts as done. A task can be set back to todo to reopen it.

date.description: The day it was completed, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

hire.description: The hire id, e.g. H-0001, or the name when only one carries it

status.description: done, skipped, or todo to put it back to outstanding

task.description: The task id, e.g. K03, as shown by onboarding_progress

name: onboarding_task_done
title: Mark a task done or skipped
